title: Allocate evidence before a rare regression escapes
description: Select a production slice, sampling policy, daily evaluation budget, and human calibration share. The model shows how evidence allocation changes uncertainty and the release response.

strategies.label: Traffic-proportional random
strategies.detail: Estimate the natural fleet mix; rare slices receive cases in proportion to traffic.

strategies.label: Stratified coverage
strategies.detail: Reserve a minimum allocation for every declared decision-critical slice.

strategies.label: Risk-weighted investigation
strategies.detail: Concentrate evidence on high-impact or suspicious slices while retaining a fleet sample.

scenarios.label: Broad support decline
scenarios.detail: A common support intent loses concise, correct answers across most tenants.

scenarios.label: Rare high-risk language
scenarios.detail: A low-volume Arabic billing slice starts producing unsupported policy answers.
scenarios.impactLabel: Low volume, high financial and trust impact

scenarios.label: Tool timeout tail
scenarios.detail: A bounded but important group of account-recovery requests loses the final tool result.
scenarios.impactLabel: Operationally recoverable, but blocks task completion
